newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Guangdong Enterprises US$500 mln notes group forms.
newsitem.headline: Guangdong Enterprises US$500 mln notes group forms.

text.p: A group has formed for Guangdong Enterprises (Holdings) Ltd's US$500 million senior notes due 2007, bookrunner Merrill Lynch & Co said.
The 10-year notes were issued and reoffered at a fixed 99.85. They pay a 8.875 percent coupon semi-annually to yield 8.898 percent, or 223 basis points over the 6.625 percent U.S. Treasury due 2007.
The notes were rated Baa3 by Moody's Investor Service and BB by Standard & Poor's.
Merrill Lynch & Co is the lead manager and bookrunner.
Credit Suisse First Boston and HSBC Securities Inc are co-managers.
